<div class="op">

<section class="op-hero">
  <div class="op-hero-text">
    <h1 class="op-display">I lead data teams for <em>mission&#8209;driven</em> organisations.</h1>
    <p class="op-lede">Building data and product at Hockeystick, a political data start-up. Previously with the Democratic National Committee for the 2024 presidential election.</p>
  </div>
  <div class="op-photo op-headshot"><img src="/assets/headshot-bw.webp" alt="Portrait of Olivia Jackson Lambert" width="800" height="1000" fetchpriority="high"></div>
</section>

<section id="work" class="op-section">
  <div class="op-head"><h2>Work &amp; Writing</h2><span class="op-label">Newest first</span></div>
  <div class="op-grid">

    <a class="op-tile" href="/project/projects_files/flight-delay-spark/flight-delay-spark.html">
      <span class="op-thumb"><img src="/project/cover_assets/thumbs/web/flight-delay.webp" alt="" width="900" height="600" loading="lazy" decoding="async"></span>
      <div class="op-meta"><span>2026</span><span>PySpark</span></div>
      <h3><span class="op-ul">Predicting Flight Delay Severity at Scale</span></h3>
      <p>A four-tier delay classifier over 31M US flights in PySpark. The chosen random forest caught 64% of delays over two hours on a blind 2019 test, the only model to clear the safety floor, at a deliberate cost to overall accuracy.</p>
    </a>

    <a class="op-tile" href="/project/projects_files/mars-terrain/mars-terrain.html">
      <span class="op-thumb"><img src="/project/cover_assets/thumbs/web/mars-terrain.webp" alt="" width="900" height="600" loading="lazy" decoding="async"></span>
      <div class="op-meta"><span>2026</span><span>TensorFlow</span></div>
      <h3><span class="op-ul">Classifying Curiosity Rover Images</span></h3>
      <p>A three-stage ResNet50 pipeline over 25 classes of Curiosity rover images, reaching 76.5% accuracy and 0.666 macro-F1. The held-out errors show the hard part is classes that look alike, not classes that are rare.</p>
    </a>

    <a class="op-tile" href="/project/projects_files/sentence-transformer/sentence-transformer.html">
      <span class="op-thumb"><img src="/project/cover_assets/thumbs/web/receipt.webp" alt="" width="900" height="600" loading="lazy" decoding="async"></span>
      <div class="op-meta"><span>2026</span><span>PyTorch</span></div>
      <h3><span class="op-ul">Multi-Task Sentence Transformer for Receipt Processing</span></h3>
      <p>One BGE-M3 backbone with two task heads, classifying receipt lines and tagging the entities inside them. On the public CORD-v2 corpus it reaches 97.8% line accuracy and 0.898 entity macro-F1.</p>
    </a>

    <a class="op-tile" href="/writing/posts/mlops-future-data-science.html">
      <span class="op-thumb"><img src="/project/cover_assets/thumbs/web/essay.webp" alt="" width="900" height="600" loading="lazy" decoding="async"></span>
      <div class="op-meta"><span>2026</span><span>Essay</span></div>
      <h3><span class="op-ul">MLOps: The Bridge Between Research and Production</span></h3>
      <p>Most machine learning projects never deliver value in production. An essay on why MLOps is more than DevOps for models, and why operational discipline now decides which organisations benefit from AI.</p>
    </a>

    <a class="op-tile" href="/project/projects_files/nba-travel/nba-travel.html">
      <span class="op-thumb"><img src="/project/cover_assets/thumbs/web/nba-travel.webp" alt="" width="900" height="600" loading="lazy" decoding="async"></span>
      <div class="op-meta"><span>2025</span><span>R</span></div>
      <h3><span class="op-ul">Does Travel Cost NBA Teams the Game?</span></h3>
      <p>A regression over 46,903 NBA games from 1947 to 2025. How far a team flies has no detectable effect on the score, but flying west to east is worth about a point.</p>
    </a>

    <a class="op-tile" href="/project/projects_files/muon-momentum-regression/muon-momentum-regression.html">
      <span class="op-thumb"><img src="/project/cover_assets/thumbs/web/muon.webp" alt="" width="900" height="600" loading="lazy" decoding="async"></span>
      <div class="op-meta"><span>2025</span><span>scikit-learn</span></div>
      <h3><span class="op-ul">Muon Track Momentum Resolution Regression</span></h3>
      <p>Predicting muon track momentum resolution from five kinematic inputs. A properly trained network reaches R² of 0.854 on 41,797 unseen tracks, against 0.698 for linear regression.</p>
    </a>

    <a class="op-tile" href="/project/projects_files/particle-classifier/particle-classifier.html">
      <span class="op-thumb"><img src="/project/cover_assets/thumbs/web/particle.webp" alt="" width="900" height="600" loading="lazy" decoding="async"></span>
      <div class="op-meta"><span>2025</span><span>TensorFlow</span></div>
      <h3><span class="op-ul">High Energy Particle CNN Classifier</span></h3>
      <p>A convolutional network that identifies particles from liquid argon detector images. Tuning the learning-rate schedule, not the architecture, lifted validation accuracy from 83.4% to 89.1%.</p>
    </a>

    <a class="op-tile" href="https://www.nature.com/articles/s41550-024-02443-0" target="_blank" rel="noopener">
      <span class="op-thumb"><img src="/project/cover_assets/thumbs/web/paper.webp" alt="" width="900" height="600" loading="lazy" decoding="async"></span>
      <div class="op-meta"><span>2024</span><span>Paper</span></div>
      <h3><span class="op-ul">How Many Samples Prove Mars Is Lifeless?</span></h3>
      <p>Second author, Nature Astronomy. A statistical case that showing a Martian environment is lifeless, with confidence, takes hundreds of samples, which shapes how sample return missions should be planned.</p>
    </a>

    <a class="op-tile" href="/project/projects_files/digit-vae/digit-vae.html">
      <span class="op-thumb"><img src="/project/cover_assets/thumbs/web/digit-vae.webp" alt="" width="900" height="600" loading="lazy" decoding="async"></span>
      <div class="op-meta"><span>2022</span><span>PyTorch</span></div>
      <h3><span class="op-ul">MNIST Variational Autoencoder</span></h3>
      <p>Compressing handwritten digits into a two-dimensional latent space and generating new ones by sampling across it. Ten digit clusters form without the model ever seeing a label.</p>
    </a>

  </div>
</section>

<section id="about" class="op-section">
  <div class="op-head"><h2>About</h2></div>
  <div class="op-about">
    <div class="op-photo op-about-photo"><img src="/assets/about.webp" alt="Olivia standing on Arthur’s Seat in Edinburgh" width="700" height="980" loading="lazy" decoding="async"></div>
    <div class="op-about-text">
      <div class="op-about-bio">
        <p>Hi! I’m <strong>Olivia Jackson Lambert</strong>, a data leader based in <strong>San Francisco</strong>. I enjoy building teams and systems that support decision making and strategy.</p>
        <p>For the last few years that has meant political and civic data, first at the Democratic National Committee and now as the Data Team Lead at Hockeystick.</p>
        <p>When I’m not working, I’m usually kayaking, reading, making art, or hanging out with my husband and three cats.</p>
      </div>
      <div class="op-facts">
        <div><span class="op-label">Currently</span><strong>Data Team Lead at Hockeystick</strong></div>
        <div><span class="op-label">Enrolled</span><strong>UC Berkeley MIDS Program</strong></div>
        <div><span class="op-label">Based in</span><strong>San Francisco, California</strong></div>
      </div>
    </div>
  </div>

  <div id="values" class="op-sub">
    <h3 class="op-subhead">Values</h3>
    <div class="op-values">
      <div class="op-value">
        <svg viewBox="0 0 40 40" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M9 31 31 9"/><path d="M15 9h16v16"/></svg>
        <h4>Model Proactivity</h4>
        <p>Empower people to search for solutions so that they can ask better questions. Provide resources and signposts over an answer every time.</p>
      </div>
      <div class="op-value">
        <svg viewBox="0 0 40 40" aria-hidden="true"><circle cx="20" cy="20" r="13"/><circle cx="20" cy="20" r="4" class="fill"/></svg>
        <h4>Champion Ownership</h4>
        <p>Allowing people to make decisions before they’re 100% ready is the fastest path to better quality work and problem solving skills.</p>
      </div>
      <div class="op-value">
        <svg viewBox="0 0 40 40" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M31 21a11 11 0 1 1-3.2-7.8"/><path d="M29 6.5v7h-7"/></svg>
        <h4>Iterate on Imperfection</h4>
        <p>In the age of AI, ideas and experiments can be prototyped faster than ever. Test multiple bets and converge on what works.</p>
      </div>
      <div class="op-value">
        <svg viewBox="0 0 40 40" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M8 16h24"/><path d="M8 24h24"/><path d="M27 8 13 32"/></svg>
        <h4>Challenge Assumptions</h4>
        <p>Question the default, no matter your seniority. Disagreement is welcome and vital for a healthy team.</p>
      </div>
      <div class="op-value">
        <svg viewBox="0 0 40 40" aria-hidden="true"><circle cx="15" cy="20" r="9.5"/><circle cx="25" cy="20" r="9.5"/></svg>
        <h4>Understand the Impact</h4>
        <p>Learn how people use data before building for them. Create constant feedback loops to empower users to be creative and contribute to product direction.</p>
      </div>
    </div>
  </div>

  <div id="experience" class="op-sub">

        <p>Building the data team from the ground up and driving product strategy, technical excellence and culture.</p>
      </li>
      <li>
        <span class="op-label op-when">2024</span><span class="op-dot" aria-hidden="true"></span>
        <strong>Senior Analytics Engineer</strong><span class="op-org">Democratic National Committee</span>
        <p>Delivered production models to campaign teams through the 2024 election cycle.</p>
      </li>

        <span class="op-label op-when">2023 to 2024</span><span class="op-dot" aria-hidden="true"></span>

      </li>

        <span class="op-label op-when">2023</span><span class="op-dot" aria-hidden="true"></span>

        <p>Introduced data engineering standards at a small European hedge fund.</p>

/* Size the About photo so it is exactly as tall as the text beside it, uncropped.
   Its width changes the text column, which rewraps the text, so settle in a few passes. */
(function () {
  var RATIO = 1815 / 2542;
  function fit() {
    var about = document.querySelector(".op-about");
    var text = about && about.querySelector(".op-about-text");
    if (!text) return;
    if (window.matchMedia("(max-width: 900px)").matches) { about.style.removeProperty("--about-photo-w"); return; }
    for (var i = 0; i < 6; i++) {
      // the text column stretches to the row, so measure its content, not the column
      var h = 0, kids = text.children, gap = parseFloat(getComputedStyle(text).rowGap) || 0;
      for (var k = 0; k < kids.length; k++) h += kids[k].getBoundingClientRect().height;
      h += gap * Math.max(0, kids.length - 1);
      var w = Math.max(220, Math.min(460, Math.round(h * RATIO)));
      var cur = parseFloat(about.style.getPropertyValue("--about-photo-w")) || 0;
      if (Math.abs(w - cur) < 1) break;
      about.style.setProperty("--about-photo-w", w + "px");
    }
  }
  var t; function soon() { clearTimeout(t); t = setTimeout(fit, 60); }
  window.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", fit);
  window.addEventListener("load", fit);
  window.addEventListener("resize", soon);
  if (document.fonts && document.fonts.ready) document.fonts.ready.then(fit);
})();
</script>
